title: Dreaming of a woman marking brick walls with chalk
content: First a little intro (you can skip this part): I recently found this sub, and I love it. This is my first post here. When describing my dreams on Reddit, people first introduced me to the backrooms, then liminal spaces, and finally the Mall World. It is comforting to know that I'm not the only person experiencing these things. I have very vivid dreams, and visit my mall world almost every night. I can go into much more detail about it all if anyone is interested. Anyway, to the point: Last night in my dream, I was walking in my mall world, talking to one of my friends, and suddenly a woman appeared with us. She was black and had a big afro, she was wearing a red jacket, white shirt and black pants. I have never seen this woman in my waking life or in a dream before. As we kept walking, the woman would casually take out a piece of chalk, and draw a single line on the corner of a building. We walked past three or four brick buildings, and she did this thing with the chalk on just one brick at the corner of each building. In the dream, I started to get a bad feeling about her, but the next thing I knew, I was awake in my bed again. I don't know what to make of all this, but I was wondering if anyone has had a similar experience in their dreams, and could shed some light on the subject. I would also just like to hear anything about your Mall World, because this is all really fascinating to me.
